decision_statement: I, /root, explicitly accept the18 enumerated new first-assessor proposals after personally reading all26 complete attention reports and freezing78 OA judgments before cartilage000 case findings, with earlier source and grading exposure disclosed. Four root source-state reconsiderations remain separately preserved, as do both readers' original freezes, reconsiderations and retained disagreements.

Ten negatives and five positives become uncertain; one unmentioned state becomes uncertain and stays masked; one uncertain state becomes explicitly below-threshold negative.
